name: Make A Website
tagline: Build and host a real website from a description.
shortDescription: Turns a plain-text description into a real, hosted single-page website — hosting, a custom domain, HTTPS, web analytics, and a contact form all included.
agentSummary: Lets an agent build and manage a user's website end to end over a REST API: create a site from a description, poll the asynchronous build, make iterative changes, read web analytics and contact-form submissions, and connect a custom domain. The agent links into the user's existing account (approved in the iOS app) and acts on their behalf; it spends the user's plan and cannot pay. OpenAPI is at https://api.makeawebsite.app/openapi.yml and agent discovery at https://agents.makeawebsite.app/llms.txt.
bestFor: Single-page sites — business landing and intro pages, restaurants, cafes, local businesses, coming-soon and contact pages.
cautionNotes: The agent acts on the user's account and spends their plan (free tier is one website; Pro and consumable Fast Passes are billed via Apple in-app purchase). The agent cannot pay — on a plan limit the API returns HTTP 402 with an upgrade_url the user completes in the iOS app. Account linking requires the user's explicit in-app approval; an agent cannot self-signup. The human steps (approval, payment) are iOS-app only.
pricingSummary: Free tier includes one website; Pro subscription unlocks unlimited sites and longer analytics history; consumable Fast Passes give instant builds. Billing is via Apple in-app purchase on the user's account.
authModel: Delegated bearer tokens via an OAuth 2.0 device-authorization flow: the agent calls /agents/link/start, the user approves the shown code in the Make A Website iOS app, and /agents/link/poll returns a maw_agt_live_ token sent as Authorization: Bearer. The agent acts on the user's behalf and the token is revocable in the app.
accountCreation: No agent self-signup. The agent links into a user's existing account, which the user approves in the Make A Website iOS app; users create their account by installing the app.
browserSupport: Not required — the full agent surface is a JSON REST API. The only human steps (approving the link and paying) happen in the iOS app, not a browser.

capabilities.detail: REST API at /api/v1 with an OpenAPI 3.1 spec: create/list/get/edit/delete sites, make changes, poll status, read analytics and form submissions, and connect custom domains.
Agent-focused discovery and docs: llms.txt, a markdown API reference, OpenAPI, an api-catalog, and a DNS-AID record at agents.makeawebsite.app.
